card.name: Cueca
card.era: Late 18th century to present; form consolidated by late 19th century
card.profile: A couples courtship dance in which partners wave handkerchiefs and trace circular figures, turns and half-turns, evoking the courtship of a rooster and hen (Britannica; Wikipedia). Danced to guitar, accordion, guitarron, harp, tambourine and handclaps, in alternating 6/8-3/4 with hemiola; structured in cuarteta, seguidilla and remate. Central to the September Fiestas Patrias; widely held to descend from the Peruvian zamacueca. Declared Chile's national dance by Decree No. 23 (Diario Oficial, 6 November 1979) (Marca Chile; Wikipedia).
card.insight: The Pinochet dictatorship's official promotion of cueca from 1979 reshaped its imagery; in protest the cueca sola debuted on 8 March 1978 in Santiago by the folk ensemble of the Association of Families of the Detained-Disappeared (AFDD), per Chile's Museo de la Memoria y los Derechos Humanos.

observation.setting: Indoor stage with a painted floor, seated audience on the left, and a live band on the back of the stage.
observation.dancers: One couple in the center foreground (man and woman), with other couples entering and dancing in the background.
observation.formation_and_space: Couples dancing independently across the floor in circular paths and figure-eights facing each other.
observation.posture: Upright torso, relaxed knees, weight shifting between feet.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping and tapping on the beat; exact foot mechanics cannot be seen clearly due to low resolution and long shot.
observation.arms_and_hands: Both dancers hold and wave white handkerchiefs overhead while circling each other.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains upright with natural movement during turns and travel; no isolated hip movements.
observation.partnering: No body contact; partners dance near each other, facing and circling one another while waving handkerchiefs.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent turns and pivoting steps while traveling in circles.
observation.costume_and_props: Man wears a dark hat, patterned poncho, dark trousers, and boots. Woman wears a white dress with red patterned ruffles and sash. Both hold white handkerchiefs.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement and heel-toe articulation cannot be determined due to video resolution.

The dancers travel in a wide circular trajectory around each other with fast footwork and overhead handkerchiefs.
